channel.title: FFIP LinkedIn rotation
channel.description: Fly Fishing Insider Podcast articles queued for LinkedIn

item.title: Moonlit Nirvana 6wt Fiberglass Fly Rod Review
item.description: Hands-on Moonlit Nirvana 6wt PhoenixGLASS fiberglass fly rod review: S-Glass blank, fast-recovering tip, reserve power in the lower blank, and how it fights bass and carp.

item.title: Non-stop Dogwear Trail Light Dog Backpack Review
item.description: Non-stop Dogwear Trail Light Dog Backpack review: sizing, the Y-shaped neck, Hexivent belly panel and safe load limits for dogs that hike and camp with you.

item.title: Cheeky PreLoad 2.0 300 Review: Pre-Rigged Fly Reel
item.description: Cheeky PreLoad 2.0 300 fly reel review: pre-spooled with backing, line and leader, S-Power Drag, 4.1 oz, verified specs, scorecard, comparison and FAQ.

item.title: How to Stay Warm Fly Fishing in Winter: 10 Ways That Work
item.description: How to stay warm fly fishing in winter: merino layers, roomy waders, one good pair of socks, mittens, hand warmers and a midday plan to keep you fishing.

item.title: Fly Fishing Gifts Under $100: 15 Picks Anglers Will Use
item.description: The best fly fishing gifts under $100, from a fiberglass fly rod and handmade cedar fly box to merino layers and tools, picked by the FFIP podcast host.

item.title: Gifts for Fly Tyers: 12 Fly Tying Gifts They'll Use
item.description: Gifts for fly tyers that earn a spot on the bench: a rotary vise, Loon and Water Mark tool kits, UV resin, a Kelly Galloup dubbing tool and Clouser tying kits.

item.title: Steelhead Alley Tactics: Read the Run, Mend, Dangle | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Great Lakes steelhead tips from the Steelhead Manifesto: study the run, mend upstream to get down, and learn why the dangle at the end of the swing pays off.

item.title: Fly Fishing Gear Upgrades - 12 Wishlist Picks for Anglers
item.description: Fly fishing gear upgrades worth putting on your holiday list: zippered waders, sticky rubber boots, a Rising net, a better reel and merino layers that work.

item.title: Fly Fishing Gifts for Beginners - 15 Picks New Anglers Use
item.description: Fly fishing gifts for beginners that a new angler will actually use: starter rod kits, flies, nippers, a Rising net, polarized glasses and the gift of a lesson.

item.title: Winter Flies for Trout - 12 Best Patterns for Cold Water
item.description: The best winter flies for trout: Zebra Midges, egg patterns, San Juan Worms, small BWO nymphs, Griffith's Gnats and a slow Woolly Bugger, plus how to fish them.

item.title: Put Your Name on Your Fly Fishing Gear | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: A Sharpie and your phone number can save a fly box, wading bag, or pair of boots. Where to write it on every piece of fishing gear.

item.title: Passing of the Torch: A New Chapter for the Podcast | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Founding host Greg Keenan hands the Fly Fishing Insider Podcast to Christian. What changes, what stays, and what listeners can expect next.

item.title: Euro Nymphing for Beginners: Rig, Sighter and Practice Tips | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Starting tight-line or Euro nymphing? Set up a simple rig, read the sighter V, and practice smart so your first season on the water goes faster.

item.title: How to Read and Rig a Stillwater: Tips from Mr. Werbs | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Aaron Smith (Mr. Werbs) shows how to read a lake by structure and wind, and how to rig an indicator leech setup for rocky banks. Practical stillwater tips.

item.title: Peacock Bass, Giant Trevally and Tigers: Lessons from Jeff Currier | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Jeff Currier shares how to fish peacock bass and giant trevally with heavy tackle: the rod, leader, fly and one rule about line that decides whether you land the fish.

item.title: Why Your Leader and Line System Matters: Lessons from Bruce Chard | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Bruce Chard explains why your line, leader and fly layout work as one system, and how a bonefish school can speed up your learning. Lessons from 30 years in the business.

item.title: What Aquatic Bugs Tell Anglers About River Health | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: An ecologist explains how mayflies, stoneflies and caddis reveal river health, and how flipping rocks and downsizing flies can save your day on the water.

item.title: How to Catch Musky on the Fly in Summer | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Musky guide Dan Donavon shares his summer game plan: lines, fly sizes, topwater tactics, where fish hold, and why the figure eight matters.

item.title: Three Ways to Research a New Fishing Spot | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Heading to unfamiliar water? Use the internet, local shops, social media and the library to learn a new fishing spot before you arrive.

item.title: Montana Fishing Film Festival: Story Over Production | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: How a borrowed camera and a Missoula screening grew into the Montana Fishing Film Festival, and what makes a fishing film worth watching.

item.title: Florida Keys Fall Grand Slams With Bruce Chard | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Bruce Chard on why fall is prime time in the Florida Keys for grand slams, and how overlining your rod helps you cast fast at short range.

item.title: Pyramid Lake Cutthroat With Arlo Townsend | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Guide Arlo Townsend explains how cutthroat cruise Pyramid Lake's shoreline drop-off and when to fish a floating line with midges versus stripping flies.

item.title: Build a Fly Tying Bench With Meaning: Lessons From Tie Craft | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: What a custom, river-themed fly tying desk teaches about building a tying space you love, plus practical tips for organizing your own bench.

item.title: Yellowstone Dry Fly Tips From a Veteran Guide | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Yellowstone and Madison River guide Alice Owsley shares dry fly tips: fish one fly, choose nylon leaders, use a sharpie, and observe before you cast.

item.title: How Fly Lines Are Built | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Scientific Anglers president Brad Befus explains fly line cores, coatings, textures and tapers, and how to pick the right line for your water.

item.title: Where Fish Live: The FEES Method for Reading Trout Water | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Use FEES (food, energy, efficiency, safety) to read any river and find the lies where trout actually sit, instead of fishing empty water.

item.title: Baseline Streamer Tactics: Swing vs. Jerk Strip | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Two baseline streamer retrieves explained: the in-alignment swing and the across-the-current jerk strip, and when to choose each one.

item.title: Fish New Water on Every Cast and Catch More Fish | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Stop casting to the same spot. Learn the new-water approach to fly fishing: better drifts, fewer spooked fish, and more opportunities.

item.title: Costa Rica Fly Fishing: Machaca, Tarpon and Rooster Fish with Jesse Males | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Jesse Males on fly fishing Costa Rica: jungle-river machaca on eight weights, Caribbean tarpon, surf-caught rooster fish, and the rigs behind them.

item.title: Tying Streamers That Hold Up | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Hunter Derrek of Meat Market Flies on building streamers that survive big fish: hook choice, proven patterns, and tying for how you really fish.
